verses.ar:
يَا إِمَامَ الرُّسْلِ يَا سَنَدِي ۞ أَنْتَ بَابُ اللّٰهِ مُعْتَمَدِي
فَبِدُنْيَايَ وَآخِرَتِي ۞ يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰهِ خُذْ بِيَدِي
verses.tr: Yā imāma-r-rusli yā sanadī · anta bābu-Llāhi muʿtamadī · Fa-bi-dunyāya wa ākhiratī · yā Rasūlallāhi khudh bi-yadī
verses.en: O leader of the messengers, O my support — you are the door of Allah on whom I rely. In my worldly life and my hereafter, O Messenger of Allah, take my hand.

verses.ar: قَسَمًا بِالنَّجْمِ حِينَ هَوَى ۞ مَا الْمُعَافَى وَالسَّقِيمُ سَوَا
verses.tr: Qasaman bi-n-najmi ḥīna hawā · mā-l-muʿāfā wa-s-saqīmu sawā
verses.en: By the star as it descends, I swear: the healthy and the ailing are not equal —

verses.ar: فَاخْلَعِ الْكَوْنَيْنِ عَنْكَ سِوَى ۞ حُبِّ مَوْلَى الْعُرْبِ وَالْعَجَمِ
verses.tr: Fa-khlaʿi-l-kawnayni ʿanka siwā · ḥubbi mawlā-l-ʿurbi wa-l-ʿajami
verses.en: so cast off both worlds from yourself, keeping only love of the master of Arabs and non-Arabs.

verses.ar: سَيِّدُ السَّادَاتِ مِنْ مُضَرِ ۞ غَوْثُ أَهْلِ الْبَدْوِ وَالْحَضَرِ
verses.tr: Sayyidu-s-sādāti min Muḍari · ghawthu ahli-l-badwi wa-l-ḥaḍari
verses.en: Master of masters from Mudar, the succor of desert dwellers and settled folk alike,

verses.ar: صَاحِبُ الْآيَاتِ وَالسُّوَرِ ۞ مَنْبَعُ الْأَحْكَامِ وَالْحِكَمِ
verses.en: keeper of the verses and the chapters, wellspring of rulings and of wisdoms.

verses.tr: Qamarun ṭābat sarīratuhu · wa sajāyāhu wa sīratuhu
verses.en: A moon whose inner essence is pure, and pure too his character and his way of life —

verses.ar: صَفْوَةُ الْبَارِي وَخِيرَتُهُ ۞ عَدْلُ أَهْلِ الْحِلِّ وَالْحَرَمِ
verses.tr: Ṣafwatu-l-Bārī wa khīratuhu · ʿadlu ahli-l-ḥilli wa-l-ḥarami
verses.en: the purest elect of the Maker and His chosen one, trusted just witness for all people, within the sanctuary and beyond.

verses.ar: مَا رَأَتْ عَيْنٌ وَلَيْسَ تَرَى ۞ مِثْلَ طٰهٰ فِي الْوَرَى بَشَرَا
verses.tr: Mā ra'at ʿaynun wa laysa tarā · mithla Ṭāhā fī-l-warā basharā
verses.en: No eye has seen, nor shall it ever see, a human being like Taha among creation —

verses.ar: خَيْرُ مَنْ مَسَّ الثَّرَى أَثَرَا ۞ طَاهِرُ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالشِّيَمِ
verses.tr: Khayru man massa-th-tharā atharā · ṭāhiru-l-akhlāqi wa-sh-shiyami
verses.en: the best whose footsteps ever touched the earth, pure in morals and in noble traits.
